cleansingStrength.rationale: Low: nonionic Decyl Glucoside #2 leads, with mild anionics Disodium Laureth Sulfosuccinate #3 and Sodium Lauryl Sulfoacetate #4 and refatting PEG-55 Propylene Glycol Oleate #5; no sulfate, no reset route.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: Two anionic routes at #3/#4 and no amphoteric; 'sulfate-free does not automatically mean low'.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Low: only a late cationic starch (Hydroxypropyl Oxidized Starch PG-Trimonium Chloride #11, after preservatives) and humectants Propylene Glycol #6, Sodium Lactate #14.

weightPotential.rationale: Low: one late light cationic polymer; no persistent deposition.

focusPrimary.rationale: scalp_active: lead manufacturer claim 'Schonende, seifenfreie Reinigung für empfindliche Kopfhaut' plus 'schützt Kopfhaut ... vor dem Austrocknen' is explicit sensitive-scalp positioning, and scalpComfortTarget is targeted (7.2 sensitive row). Not merely mildness because the claim names a scalp condition.
focusPrimary.counterSignal: Much of the copy is mildness/everyday language, which alone is not a focus (7.2); no listed comfort route; fragrance.
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Blind: very mild glucoside system, minimal conditioning -> gentle chassis, no specialist route. Unblind: sensitive-scalp lead claim + targeted -> scalp_active.

focusSecondary.rationale: Empty: 'mehr Fülle und Glanz' (retailer) has no independent route and is an outcome claim.

usageRole.rationale: Frequent: 'Every-Day' in name, 'für die tägliche Haarwäsche', and cleansingStrength low (not strong) (§9).

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Targeted: explicit sensitive-scalp positioning ('für empfindliche Kopfhaut', 'Widerstandskräfte gegen Reizeinflüsse') with supportive architecture: genuinely mild glucoside-led cleansing, pH 5.5 lactic acid/sodium lactate buffer, refatting PEG-55 PG Oleate #5. Counter: fragrance #7; no allantoin/panthenol-type comfort route.

projection.thicknessRationale: Proposed target ordinary (S-FAIL): T1 W low, C low -> fine ideal, normal ideal, coarse acceptable. T4: no neighbors on W or C -> no flags.
projection.scalpTargetRationale: S-SENSITIVE: E2 'empfindliche Kopfhaut' (manufacturer, E1 moderate) passes; formula: targeted passes but no prominent E4 comfort route (prominent set before Parfum #7: Decyl Glucoside, Disodium Laureth Sulfosuccinate, Sodium Lauryl Sulfoacetate, PEG-55 Propylene Glycol Oleate, Propylene Glycol - none listed) -> fails. S-DRY: 'schützt Kopfhaut ... vor dem Austrocknen' is a protective statement, not a listed dry-scalp claim; even if accepted, no prominent listed humectant (Sodium Lactate #14 is after Parfum) -> would fail. No other specialist target -> S-FAIL: propose ordinary + review_specialist_gate_failed. S-FOCUS cannot fire (no specialist target projected) even though focus is scalp_active.
projection.cleansingIntensityRationale: I1: low -> gentle (ordinary bucket expects regular; I2 keeps gentle -> amber). I3: neighbor moderate -> regular, equal to the projected bucket's expected intensity while gentle is not -> review_intensity_boundary.
projection.liveComparison: Not evaluated (live rows not in sealed packet).

uncertainties: §10 accepts 'mild/balanced cleansing' and pH/barrier support as supportive architecture for targeted, but S-SENSITIVE then demands a prominent E4 comfort route that a minimalist sensitive-scalp formula need not contain; a product can be scalp_active/targeted yet fail its target gate. Resolved by S-FAIL (review).
E2 dry lexicon does not cover protective wording ('schützt ... Kopfhaut vor dem Austrocknen'); treated as not qualifying.
I3 here fires toward a stronger-intensity reading that would make the ordinary row green; the standard does not distinguish the direction of I3 flags.
